onboarding.title: One more step
onboarding.description: Your Firebase account has no application account yet.
onboarding.company_hint: Fill this in only if you are starting a new garage. If you were invited, leave it empty.

roles.subtitle: {{count}} roles
roles.add_hint: Every role here belongs to this garage alone. Copying an existing one is the usual start: take the closest role, then take rights away.
roles.code_hint: Letters, digits and underscores, e.g. SERVICE_ADVISOR

errors.AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: The backend has no Firebase credentials configured, so nobody can sign in.
errors.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: Somebody else changed this record in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The garage must keep at least one owner.
errors.PLATE_ALREADY_REGISTERED: A car with this plate is already registered here.
errors.STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No file storage is configured, so files cannot be uploaded.
errors.MILEAGE_WENT_BACKWARDS: The reading is lower than the last one recorded for this car.
errors.ANNUAL_MILEAGE_REQUIRED: A service needs the car's yearly distance — that is what the reminder is built on.
errors.MILEAGE_REQUIRED: A service has to record the mileage it was done at.
errors.NOT_A_MECHANIC: Only a colleague holding the MECHANIC role can be handed the work.
errors.CUSTOMER_HAS_VEHICLES: Remove or reassign the customer's cars first.
errors.LAST_LOCATION: A garage needs at least one open location.
errors.BIG_SERVICE_TOO_SOON: The major service cannot come more often than the small one.
errors.SERVICE_ORDER_CLOSED: This order is closed and no longer changes.
errors.SERVICE_ORDER_DONE: Finished work is history and cannot be removed.
errors.CANCELLATION_REASON_REQUIRED: Say why the order is being cancelled.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: You are not allowed on this page.

login.title: Sign in
login.headline: The cars, the work and the customers who come back.
login.subheadline: Every car's service history, every job priced your way, and a reminder to the customer before the next one is due.
login.invite_only: Accounts are created by invitation — ask the owner of your garage for one.
login.footnote: RepairShop OS — the workshop, the customers and the reminders, for garages.

workshop.title: The workshop, priced your way
workshop.body: Small and major services and repairs, labour per hour or flat, parts, photographs and invoices on every order, and a quote to print.

reminders.title: Customers who come back
reminders.body: From the mileage and how far they drive in a year, the car says when its next service falls — and the customer hears about it in time.

notebook.title: The mechanics' notebook
notebook.body: How that job on that car is done, with the pictures and documents, found again by make and model.

customers.subtitle: {{count}} customers
customers.company_hint: For a company car: the company is named on the quote and the person, if given, in brackets.
customers.email_hint: Where the service reminders go. Without it the customer is not written to.
customers.locale_hint: The language reminders and the quote are written in.

vehicles.subtitle: {{count}} cars
vehicles.new_hint: The plate identifies the car. The reading and the yearly distance are what the next service is forecast from.
vehicles.plate_hint: Spaces and dashes do not matter: BG 123-AB and bg123ab are the same car.
vehicles.annual_hint: Roughly how many kilometres the car does in a year. Asked again at every service.
vehicles.confirm_delete: Remove this car? Its orders stay on record.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.no_history: No service on record yet. The forecast starts with the first finished service.
maintenance.expected: Expected around {{date}}. The customer is emailed two weeks before.
maintenance.no_date: No date without a yearly distance and a reading.

workshop.subtitle: {{count}} orders
workshop.open_hint: Taking a car in. A service asks the yearly distance, because that is what the next reminder is built on.
workshop.mechanic_hint: Leave empty to take the job yourself; otherwise a colleague holding the MECHANIC role.
workshop.annual_required: A service needs the yearly distance.
workshop.labour_hint: Hours times the rate, or the fixed amount once any hours are recorded. Copied from the garage settings when the order was opened; change it here for this order only.
workshop.no_orders: This car has not been in yet.
workshop.confirm_cancel: Why is this order being cancelled?
workshop.reason_placeholder: A sentence is enough — it stays on the record.

attachments.title: Files
attachments.hint: Photographs of the fault, the parts invoice, a diagnostic printout.
attachments.limits: Images and PDF, up to 20 MB each
attachments.upload_failed: Storage refused {{name}}. Nothing was recorded for it.

notes.subtitle: {{count}} notes
notes.confirm_delete: Remove this note and its files?
notes.vehicle_hint: When the note is about one particular car rather than a type.
notes.limits: Images, PDF, text and office documents, up to 20 MB each

garage.subtitle: What holds for the whole garage: service intervals, the price of work, the language customers are written in.

intervals.title: Service intervals
intervals.hint: How far a car goes between small services and between major ones. The reminders are built on these.

pricing.title: Labour pricing
pricing.hint: Per hour, or one fixed amount per job. An order copies the pricing when it is opened, so changing it here never reprices old work.

contact.title: Language and contact
contact.hint: New customers get this language unless they say otherwise. The phone and email are printed in every reminder.

locations.subtitle: Where the garage works. Every order names one.
locations.empty: No locations yet — a "Main" one is created with the first order.
locations.confirm_close: Close this location? Its orders stay on record.
